top_choice_rationale: P003 recognizes a mature, transformative and coherently bounded contribution: rigorous theoretical and experimental establishment of reciprocity, fairness and inequity aversion as economically consequential motivations. Its proposed trio provides a more defensible allocation of credit than the broader programme-level alternatives, provided the citation remains narrowly confined to these contributions.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile; documented coauthor and institutional connections do not identify a connection to the proposed laureates.
